tasks.name: Finalize campaign brief – 'Your Next Obsession'
tasks.notes: Campaign brief locked on Concept A: acquisition-focused, headline 'Your Next Obsession'. Approved by Jonathan. Circulate final PDF to full project team and Paramount+ stakeholders.

tasks.name: Audience insights & competitive landscape report
tasks.notes: Hannah to deliver streaming-category audience segmentation: cord-cutters 25-44, lapsed subscribers, and genre-affinity cohorts (crime drama, reality, sports). Include competitive share-of-voice snapshot for Netflix, Hulu, Max.

tasks.name: Concept A selection confirmed – kick off 'Your Next Obsession' creative
tasks.notes: Jonathan selected Concept A for its acquisition focus over Concept B (retention/loyalty angle). Bella to lead production on 6-second, 15-second, and 30-second versions. Initial storyboards due Friday Oct 31.

tasks.name: Storyboards – 6s, 15s, 30s versions (all three cuts)
tasks.notes: Produce initial storyboards for all three ad lengths for client review. Formats: 9:16 vertical (TikTok, Reels, Stories) and 16:9 landscape (YouTube, CTV). Due Friday Oct 31. Devon to art direct; Sofia on copy.

tasks.name: Copy – tagline variants for 'Your Next Obsession'
tasks.notes: Develop 3–5 headline variants riffing on 'Your Next Obsession' for A/B testing across YouTube pre-roll and TikTok. Must work truncated for 6-second cut. Sofia primary; Jonathan to approve.

tasks.name: Art direction – master visual system for fall slate
tasks.notes: Build out the master visual system: color temperature, typography treatment, show-art integration rules for the fall slate (Tulsa King S3, Lioness S2, Smile 3). Must work across 9:16 and 16:9 formats.

tasks.name: Production schedule – 6s / 15s / 30s delivery timeline
tasks.notes: Bella to build out full production schedule integrating storyboard review, client feedback round, edit, legal review window (mandatory 3 business days), and final delivery by Nov 14 for Nov 18 launch.

tasks.name: Add legal review window to project schedule & approval tracker
tasks.notes: Jonathan requested mandatory 3-business-day legal review before any asset goes live. Bella confirmed this will be built into the schedule. Eli to update the approval tracker template to include legal sign-off gate.

tasks.name: Asset specs – 9:16 and 16:9 delivery requirements doc
tasks.notes: Jonathan requested final assets include both 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios. Bella to produce a formal asset spec sheet covering dimensions, file format, audio spec, duration limits, and platform requirements for YouTube, TikTok, CTV, Meta.

tasks.name: Edit suite – book post-production vendor for final cuts
tasks.notes: Confirm post-production partner for video editing. Bella to reach out to Blackframe Edit and Whiteboard Studios for availability Nov 3–12. Budget cleared by Brenda ($18K production line item).

tasks.name: Final media plan – $120K budget (TikTok $10K shifted to YouTube)
tasks.notes: Brenda proposed initial $120K media budget. Jonathan adjusted allocation: $10K shifted from TikTok to YouTube to leverage YouTube's stronger video completion rates for 15s and 30s cuts. Final split: YouTube $45K, CTV $30K, TikTok $15K, Meta $20K, Pinterest $10K.

tasks.name: Consolidated campaign timeline delivery – due Thursday
tasks.notes: Brenda to deliver the consolidated campaign timeline by Thursday Oct 30. Must include: media flight dates, platform go-live schedule, asset delivery deadlines, legal review windows, and client approval checkpoints.

tasks.name: Platform trafficking – YouTube, TikTok, Meta, CTV setup
tasks.notes: Tariq to set up campaign trafficking across YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Business Manager, and CTV DSP. Targeting parameters per brief: age 25-49, streaming-interest audiences, lookalike from existing P+ subscribers.

tasks.name: Legal review – 30s cut (mandatory 3 business days)
tasks.notes: Route 30s final cut to Paramount+ legal team for mandatory 3-business-day review before any distribution. Legal review window: Nov 11–13. Confirm receipt and start of review with Paramount+ legal contact.

tasks.name: Legal review – 15s and 6s cuts
tasks.notes: Route 15s and 6s final cuts to legal for concurrent 3-day review alongside 30s. All three must clear legal before any platform goes live Nov 18.

tasks.name: Client final approval – all assets sign-off
tasks.notes: Final client sign-off required from Paramount+ brand team before trafficking. Must have written approval (email or Asana approval) for each cut and each format.

tasks.name: Launch day go-live checklist – November 18
tasks.notes: Eli to own launch checklist: confirm all trafficking is live by 9am ET, verify ad units are serving on each platform, share launch confirmation with Priya and Paramount+ client contact.

tasks.name: Day-1 performance pulse – impressions & completion rate snapshot
tasks.notes: Tariq to pull a same-day snapshot by 5pm ET on Nov 18: impressions served, video completion rates by platform/cut length, any trafficking issues. Share in #ext-paramount Slack channel.

tasks.name: October content calendar – final post schedule
tasks.notes: 12 posts for October covering: NFL on CBS, Tulsa King midseason, Smile 3 home premiere, Yellowstone anniversary rewatch campaign. All copy and creative approved. Schedule loaded into Sprout Social.

tasks.name: November content calendar – draft for client review
tasks.notes: Draft November calendar aligned to fall campaign launch window and holiday streaming push. Key moments: campaign launch Nov 18, Thanksgiving weekend programming, Cyber Monday subscriber offer.

tasks.name: September performance report – deliver to Paramount+
tasks.notes: Deliver monthly paid+organic performance report. September highlights: +22% reach YoY, top-performing post: Tulsa King S3 trailer clip (4.2M impressions). Include benchmark vs streaming competitor avg.

tasks.name: Campaign positioning – genre-breaking action hero brief
tasks.notes: Hannah and Marcus to co-develop campaign positioning for Rift Protocol. Lead angle: 'break every genre'. Target: core gamers 18-35 and lapsed players. Differentiate from competitor FPS titles in Q1 window.

tasks.name: Launch trailer concepting – 90s cinematic cut
tasks.notes: Devon to concept a 90-second cinematic launch trailer targeting YouTube and Twitch pre-roll. Must showcase open-world scale, hero character, and multiplayer. NOVA to provide game capture footage by Nov 15.

stories.task_name: Concept A selection confirmed – kick off 'Your Next Obsession' creative
stories.text: Jonathan confirmed in #ext-paramount today: Concept A is locked. Acquisition-focused angle is the right call given P+'s Q4 subscriber targets. Bella is officially kicked off on production.

stories.task_name: Final media plan – $120K budget (TikTok $10K shifted to YouTube)
stories.text: Jonathan adjusted the allocation in today's channel discussion — $10K shifted from TikTok to YouTube to take advantage of stronger completion rates on 15s and 30s pre-roll. Brenda updating the plan now.

stories.task_name: Final media plan – $120K budget (TikTok $10K shifted to YouTube)
stories.text: Final allocation confirmed: YouTube $45K, CTV $30K, Meta $20K, TikTok $15K, Pinterest $10K. Consolidated timeline will be in everyone's hands by Thursday.

stories.task_name: Add legal review window to project schedule & approval tracker
stories.text: Bella confirmed that the 3-business-day legal review window and both delivery formats (9:16 + 16:9) are being integrated into the full project schedule and approval tracker.
Jonathan flagged that all final assets must deliver in both 9:16 (social/TikTok) and 16:9 (YouTube/CTV). Devon is building both orientations into the storyboard treatment from the start.

Report delivered and shared with Paramount+ team. Key finding: cord-cutters 35-44 are the highest-intent segment for acquisition this fall — over-indexing on crime drama and reality. Informing our targeting strategy.

stories.task_name: September performance report – deliver to Paramount+
stories.text: Report delivered Oct 14. Paramount+ was pleased with the reach growth (+22% YoY). They asked us to add a subscriber conversion attribution section for October's report.

stories.task_name: Campaign positioning – genre-breaking action hero brief
stories.text: Aligning with NOVA on 'break every genre' territory. They love it but want to make sure we don't lean too hard into cynical gamer humor — they want broad reach, not just core gamers.

stories.task_name: Consolidated campaign timeline delivery – due Thursday
stories.text: This is the critical-path deliverable for the week. If the timeline slips, it puts legal review at risk. Tagging as urgent.

stories.task_name: RFP response – streaming platform (pitch deck due Nov 7)
stories.text: We're leading with the Paramount+ Summer Movie Month case study — 14% over subscriber target is a strong anchor. Jonathan wants a dedicated slide on the 'Your Next Obsession' concept as proof of acquisition creative capability.
